title: Picker reasoning effort per-target + 4 model Bynara / Per-target reasoning-effort picker plus 4 Bynara models
summary: ID: Chat Lab mendapat dropdown reasoning effort per-target dan 4 model Bynara reasoning max baru (priority 300-330). / EN: Chat Lab gained a per-target reasoning-effort dropdown and 4 new Bynara reasoning-max models (priority 300-330).
problem_before: ID: Effort reasoning hanya global; model reasoning baru Bynara (agnes-3-flash, longcat-2.5, space-bunny-alpha) belum tersedia di Lab. / EN: Reasoning effort was global-only; new Bynara reasoning models (agnes-3-flash, longcat-2.5, space-bunny-alpha) were not yet available in Lab.
solution: ID: Field reasoningOverride di runLLMCompletion via applyReasoningOverride (off mematikan semua knob; nilai effort menimpa effort, thinking eksplisit DB tetap menang); migrasi tambah 4 model naraya priority 300-330 applied prod via MCP. / EN: Added a reasoningOverride field in runLLMCompletion via applyReasoningOverride (off disables all knobs; an effort value overrides effort, explicit DB thinking still wins); migration adding 4 naraya models at priority 300-330 applied to prod via MCP.
reason: ID: Uji adil antar model reasoning butuh kontrol effort per-target dalam satu run. / EN: Fair comparison across reasoning models needs per-target effort control within one run.
user_impact: ID: Tiap target Lab bisa diset Ikut model/off/low/medium/high/max sebelum submit. / EN: Each Lab target can be set to follow-model/off/low/medium/high/max before submit.
tech_impact: ID: Kontrak completion + validasi Lab berubah; migrasi DB model LLM (submodule e139a8d). / EN: Lab completion contract plus validation changed; LLM model DB migration (submodule e139a8d).

validation.build: not-verified: build outcome not recorded for 3620097
validation.lint: typecheck passed, eslint passed (per project memory 2026-09-27)

risks: ID: Kombinasi effort + thinking eksplisit bisa membingungkan bila keduanya diset. / EN: Combined effort plus explicit thinking can confuse when both are set.
migration_notes: ID: Migrasi model LLM wajib applied di prod sebelum 4 model dipakai. / EN: The LLM model migration must be applied in prod before using the 4 models.
next_steps: ID: Deploy Vercel + live verify 4 model baru di /id/lab. / EN: Deploy to Vercel plus live-verify the 4 new models in /id/lab.
